subject: Physics
title: Oscillations
summary: Jo motion barabar intervals par dohraaye wo periodic hai; mean position ke aage-peeche wali periodic motion oscillation hai.
Simple harmonic motion (SHM) tab hota hai jab restoring force displacement ke proportional aur ulta ho: F = −kx. Tab x = A sin(ωt + φ), ω = √(k/m).
SHM mein speed mean position par maximum aur extremes par zero; acceleration ulta. Total energy ½kA² constant, KE aur PE mein bantti rehti hai.
Spring–mass: T = 2π√(m/k). Simple pendulum (chhota angle): T = 2π√(l/g), mass aur amplitude se independent.

formulas.name: Periodic motion
formulas.when: Time period, frequency aur angular frequency convert karna.

formulas.name: SHM condition
formulas.when: Check karna ki motion SHM hai ya nahi.
formulas.mistake: Diameter par project ki gayi uniform circular motion SHM hai, par uchhalti ball periodic hai, SHM nahi — confuse mat karo.

formulas.name: Displacement in SHM
formulas.formula: x = A sin(ωt + φ)  (or A cos(ωt + φ))
formulas.when: Kisi bhi time par position; φ initial phase.

formulas.name: Velocity in SHM
formulas.formula: v = Aω cos(ωt + φ) = ±ω√(A² − x²);   v_max = Aω (at x = 0)

formulas.name: Acceleration in SHM
formulas.formula: a = −ω² x;   a_max = ω² A (at x = ±A)
formulas.mistake: Acceleration hamesha mean position ki taraf — x ke ulta, dhyan rakho.

formulas.name: Energy in SHM
formulas.formula: KE = ½ k(A² − x²);  PE = ½ k x²;  E = ½ k A² = ½ m ω² A²
formulas.mistake: KE = PE x = A/√2 par, A/2 par nahi.

formulas.name: Spring–mass system
formulas.mistake: Vertical spring mein bhi same formula — gravity sirf mean position shift karti hai, bhoolo mat.

formulas.name: Cut spring
formulas.formula: k ∝ 1/length: cutting a spring into n equal parts gives each part nk

formulas.name: Simple pendulum
formulas.mistake: T bob ke mass ya amplitude (chhote swings) par depend nahi karta — galat maat maano.

formulas.name: Pendulum with effective g
formulas.formula: T = 2π√(l/g_eff);  lift accelerating up: g + a;  down: g − a;  car with horizontal a: √(g² + a²)
formulas.when: Lift aur accelerating vehicles mein pendulum.

formulas.name: Phase relations
formulas.formula: velocity leads displacement by π/2;  acceleration leads displacement by π

examples.title: SHM equation padhna
examples.problem: x = 5 sin(πt + π/3) cm. Amplitude, period, maximum speed aur maximum acceleration?
examples.solution: A = 5 cm, ω = π rad/s → T = 2π/ω = 2 s. v_max = Aω ≈ 15.7 cm/s, a_max = Aω² ≈ 49.3 cm/s².

examples.problem: Amplitude 10 cm. Kis displacement par KE = PE?
examples.solution: ½k(A² − x²) = ½kx² → x = A/√2 ≈ 7.07 cm.

topics.title: Periodic functions
topics.explain: sin ωt aur cos ωt har 2π/ω par dohraate hain, isliye koi bhi periodic motion inse likhi ja sakti hai. sin ωt + cos ωt bhi SHM hai (amplitude √2, phase shifted); sin² ωt periodic hai, period π/ω.

topics.title: SHM and circular motion
topics.explain: Circle par uniform chalte particle ka kisi diameter par projection SHM karta hai. Radius = amplitude aur angular speed = ω — do positions ke beech ka time nikaalne mein kaam aata hai.

topics.title: Graphs of SHM
topics.explain: x, v, a teeno sinusoidal, same ω. v x se π/2 aage, a x se π aage. v–x graph ellipse; a–x graph negative slope wali seedhi line.

topics.title: Energy graphs
topics.explain: Potential energy (PE) parabola, minimum x = 0 par; kinetic energy (KE) ulta parabola; dono ka sum horizontal line. KE aur PE dono 2ν frequency (SHM ki double) se oscillate karte hain.

topics.title: Restoring force and force constant
topics.explain: Spring constant k batata hai system kitna stiff hai. Har SHM mein ω² = (restoring force per unit displacement)/mass. Pendulum mein mg sinθ ≈ mgθ restoring force se ω² = g/l.

topics.title: Deriving the pendulum period
topics.explain: Pivot ke baare mein torque −mgl sinθ ≈ −mglθ; I = ml² se α = −(g/l)θ. α = −ω²θ se compare karke T = 2π√(l/g).

topics.title: Time between positions
topics.explain: Mean se extreme tak T/4. Mean se A/2 tak T/12; A/2 se A tak T/6. Mean se A/√2 tak T/8.
